## Goal

As a sound designer I want the CLI commands on every recipe page to actually run, and a test that proves the committed blocks match what the generator emits, so I can trust the book as a reference.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 2 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

Every recipe page documents `toneforge show <name>` (positional), all CLI-block text comes from one shared builder, and a regeneration-based freshness test fails whenever a committed block diverges from the generator.

## Definition of done

- `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by `toneforge show <name>` (the command requires a positional name) in `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and in the duplicate builder inside `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts`.
- The duplicated command list is replaced by one exported `buildCliBlock(name)` used by both scripts, so block text has a single source of truth.
- `expectCliBlockFresh` in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` regenerates the block with the shared builder and compares it byte-for-byte with the block committed between the markers, rather than only asserting that markers exist.
- All 100 recipe pages are regenerated; a second regeneration is byte-identical.
- `toneforge show <name>` is executed successfully against the real CLI for a sample of at least three book recipes.

## Constraints

- Fix the generators and regenerate; no hand edits to generated pages.
- Do not change the block's command set beyond the `show` correction (tier-aware per-page blocks remain out of scope, tracked as TF-0MV4Z4O8I008IZZX).
- Preserve the `CLI_BLOCK_START` / `CLI_BLOCK_END` marker convention and UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` is a standalone CLI script not imported elsewhere. Mitigation: grep for imports before refactoring both generators onto one helper.
- `toneforge show` accepts a positional recipe name and not `--recipe` (verified with `toneforge show --help`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every CLI command shown in the book is valid: `toneforge show --recipe <name>` is replaced by the correct positional form (`toneforge show <name>`) on all 100 recipe pages, and the generators that emit it are corrected so a regeneration produces the same, valid output (second run byte-identical).
- A single shared block builder is the only source of CLI-block text, used by both `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` and `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` (no duplicated command list).
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` fails when a committed block is edited out of sync, by regenerating the block and comparing it byte-for-byte with the committed block between the markers.
- `toneforge show <recipe-name>` succeeds on the CLI for at least three book recipes, and the corrected pages carry that exact form.
- Regeneration is idempotent (second run byte-identical) and the recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — fix the `show` command; export the shared builder.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — use the shared builder; fix the `show` command.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — real regeneration-and-compare freshness gate.
- `docs/recipe-book/*.md` — regenerated recipe pages output.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the link-integrity slice (both slices edit `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` and `generate-pages.ts`; serialising avoids conflicts).

## Deliverables

A shared CLI-block builder with a valid `show` command, 100 regenerated recipe pages, and a genuine freshness gate in the recipe-book test battery.

## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want the capstone CLI blocks to be machine-verifiable, so the commands on the 10 capstone pages cannot go stale without failing the suite.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 3 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

Each of the 10 capstone pages wraps its CLI commands in `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START … -->` … `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` markers emitted by the generator, and the freshness gate covers them as well as the 100 recipe pages.

## Definition of done

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` emits markers around the capstone CLI block, using the same convention and regeneration hint as the recipe pages.
- The 10 capstone pages are regenerated and a second run is byte-identical.
- The freshness gate in `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` covers the 10 capstone pages in addition to the 100 recipe pages.
- The capstone commands (`toneforge stack …`, `toneforge sequence …`) are validated against the CLI.
- Capstone narrative, structure and preset data are unchanged — markers only.

## Constraints

- Reuse the existing recipe-page marker convention; do not invent a second format.
- No changes to capstone preset JSON, narrative text or `## At a glance` tables.
- Preserve idempotent generation; UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- The capstone CLI renderer (`renderCli`) is deterministic, so wrapping it in markers does not affect idempotence. Mitigation: assert a byte-identical second run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every one of the 10 capstone pages contains a `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_START` marker and a matching `<!-- CLI_BLOCK_END -->` marker wrapping its CLI commands.
- The markers are emitted by `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts`, so regeneration reproduces them (second run byte-identical).
- The `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` freshness gate covers all 10 capstone pages and fails if a capstone block is edited out of sync.
- The commands inside the capstone blocks resolve on the CLI (`toneforge stack` and `toneforge sequence` usage verified).

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — emit the CLI-block markers.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — extend the freshness gate to capstone pages.
- `docs/recipe-book/*_stack.md` — regenerated capstone output.
- `docs/recipe-book/*_sequence.md` — regenerated capstone output.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI-block freshness slice (it extends that slice's freshness helper and edits the same test file).

## Deliverables

Marker-emitting capstone generator, 10 regenerated capstone pages, and freshness coverage for capstone CLI blocks.

data.description:
## Goal

As a game developer I want one page that shows how to find, evaluate and understand the 100 sounds from the CLI, so I do not have to piece commands together from several demo walkthroughs.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 4 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

`docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a generated **Working with the CLI** section covering find / evaluate / understand-creation with copy-pasteable commands, linked from `README.md` § Documentation.

## Definition of done

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` emits the section as static generated text; a second run is byte-identical.
- The section covers:
  - **Find** — `toneforge list recipes --search <text>`, `--category <name>`, `--tags casual`, `--json`; `toneforge show <name>`; `toneforge library list` and `toneforge library search`.
  - **Evaluate** — `toneforge generate --recipe <name> --output <file.wav>`, `toneforge play <file.wav>`, `toneforge analyze`, `toneforge classify`, `toneforge explore`, `toneforge visualize`, `toneforge tui`.
  - **Understand how they were created** — `toneforge show <name>`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, and the ToneGraph schema / node-kind material (`../tonegraph.md`, and `../modules/index.md` when it lands).
- `README.md` § Documentation links the CLI-workflow material.
- A test asserts the section exists and that every recipe / stack / sequence name it references resolves (registry or `presets/`).
- Every command in the section is valid against the current CLI.

## Constraints

- Extend the generated `docs/recipe-book/index.md`; do not add a new document (a separate `docs/recipe-book/README.md` was rejected at intake).
- Keep the existing catalogue structure, front matter and roster order intact.
- Prose documentation only — no new demo, web UI or CLI behaviour. Match the real CLI (`--help` verified). UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- The named commands and flags exist in the current CLI. Verified via `--help` for `show`, `list`, `library`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui` and `generate`; the implementing session re-validates by running them.
- The section stays scannable: one short command block per surface rather than a full tutorial.
- `docs/modules/index.md` (TF-0MV29HYZU001WUW7) may still be in review; the link is added only if the file exists, otherwise the ToneGraph reference is used.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` gains a **Working with the CLI** section covering **find** (`list recipes` with `--search`/`--category`/`--tags`/`--json`, `show`, `library list`/`library search`), **evaluate** (`generate`, `play`, `analyze`, `classify`, `explore`, `visualize`, `tui`) and **understand how they were created** (`show`, the page's `## Sound design` section, `presets/recipes/*.yaml`, the ToneGraph schema/node-kind index) — with copy-paste commands, and linked from `README.md` § Documentation.
- The section is emitted by `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` and survives regeneration byte-identically.
- A test asserts the section exists and that every recipe / stack / sequence name referenced in it resolves (registry or `presets/`).
- Every command shown in the section is valid against the current CLI (executed or checked with `--help`).
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- The recipe-book test file passes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — emit the Working with the CLI section.
- `docs/recipe-book/index.md` — regenerated index with the new section.
- `./README.md` — link the CLI-workflow material from § Documentation.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — section-presence and referenced-name test.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI-block freshness slice (shares the test file and the regenerated book baseline).

## Deliverables

Generated CLI-workflow section in the recipe-book index, README link, and a test that keeps the section's referenced names honest.

data.description:
## Goal

As a ToneForge maintainer I want an end-to-end verification that the whole book is reproducible and every documented command runs, so the review is provably complete rather than assumed.

**Parent:** TF-0MV290BG8003GXXH — Review the 100 sound library documentation. This is slice 5 of 5 (vertical slices: links → CLI blocks → capstone markers → CLI-workflow section → verification).

## Target outcome

All recipe-book generators are run twice with byte-identical output, every command documented in the book is validated against the CLI, and the full project test suite passes.

## Definition of done

- All generators (`generate-pages.ts`, `generate-cli-blocks.ts`, `generate-capstones.ts`, `generate-index.ts`) are run twice; the second run leaves `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` empty.
- Every `toneforge …` command documented in the book is extracted and validated — executed where safe and cheap, otherwise its verb/flags checked against `--help` — with the results recorded in a work-item comment.
- `npm run typecheck` and the full `npm test` suite pass.
- Any command that does not run is either fixed in the owning generator or captured as a `discovered-from` follow-up, never silently ignored.

## Constraints

- Verification only: do not add new features beyond what the sibling slices deliver, and do not change recipe content or architecture.
- Use temporary output paths for commands that write files (`generate`, `visualize`) and clean up afterwards; never commit generated churn.
- UK English.

## Risky assumptions

- `toneforge tui` is interactive and cannot be executed headlessly. Mitigation: validate it via `--help`/usage instead of launching it.
- Some commands require audio device access (`play`). Mitigation: validate usage/`--help` and use a known existing WAV only when a player is available.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` enforces **real** CLI-block freshness (regenerate and compare, not just marker presence) and link integrity, and the capstone CLI blocks carry machine-readable markers so they are covered too.
- Running every recipe-book generator twice leaves `git status --porcelain docs/recipe-book` empty (byte-identical regeneration), and the result is recorded on the parent item.
- Every `toneforge` command documented in `docs/recipe-book/` is validated against the CLI (executed, or checked against `--help` when interactive or costly), with the outcome recorded.
- `npm run typecheck` passes and the full project test suite passes with the new changes.
- Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Key Files

- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-pages.ts` — idempotence verification.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-capstones.ts` — idempotence verification.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-index.ts` — idempotence verification.
- `scripts/recipe-book/generate-cli-blocks.ts` — idempotence verification.
- `src/recipes/recipe-book.test.ts` — confirm the strengthened gates are active and green.

## Dependencies

Blocked by all four implementation slices (links, CLI blocks, capstone markers, CLI-workflow section).

## Deliverables

Recorded double-run idempotence evidence, validated documented commands, and a green typecheck plus full test suite.
